caption: The drawing features a single object resembling an ornate metal basin or tray with a decorative handle. The object has a predominantly brownish color with tonal variations suggesting a metallic, possibly rusty surface. The main body of the basin is oval-shaped with a scalloped edge, each scallop containing a small round indentation or design element. Attached to the interior of the basin is an upright handle placed centrally, which features two supports that curve outward and meet at a horizontal bar with ornamental scrollwork. The handle and its supports are also decorated with matching brown tones and shading to enhance their three-dimensional appearance. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background, and near the bottom right corner, the name "John H. Tercuzzi" is written in small, fine letters.
title: Foot Scraper and Tray
